notes.title: MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics - Title Update Apr 16!
notes.content:
A title update is coming to MARVEL vs. CAPCOM Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics on Wednesday, April 16th!

[previewyoutube=4zTTwFVmrLk;full][/previewyoutube]
Versus Mode will be added to all fighting titles in the collection and settings can be changed for each game.

Also, enjoy newly drawn artwork by CAPCOM artist Shinkiro, new remix tracks by CAPCOM's internal band "CAP-JAMS", and additional features and quality of life enhancements!

This collection spans across multiple titles starting with the first fighting game collaboration, X-MEN CHILDREN OF THE ATOM all the way to the legendary beat 'em up, THE PUNISHER!
 
All titles support online multiplayer so take this chance to get your hands on these classic games even if you didn't get to experience them at the arcades! 
 
Titles:
・X-MEN CHILDREN OF THE ATOM
・MARVEL SUPER HEROES
・X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER
・MARVEL SUPER HEROES vs. STREET FIGHTER
・MARVEL vs. CAPCOM CLASH OF SUPER HEROES
・MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes
・THE PUNISHER

© 2025 MARVEL　©CAPCOM

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2634890/MARVEL_vs_CAPCOM_Fighting_Collection_Arcade_Classics/
